name: WEDCO
old_description: This year, we proudly celebrate 75 years of delivering trusted solutions! Since 1950, WEDCO has been built on strong relationships and dedicated leadership. We’re especially grateful to the Elmore Family, whose vision and commitment guided us for decades. In 2008, we began transitioning ownership from the Elmores, and today, we’re proudly 100% employee-owned.
about:
WEDCO is headquartered in Reno, Nevada, and was founded in 1950 by the Elmore family. The company transitioned to employee ownership in 2008 and is now 100% employee-owned. It operates four locations across Northern Nevada: Reno, Fallon, Carson City, and Winnemucca.

The company operates as an electrical distributor and solutions provider, carrying over $10 million in inventory from brands such as Square D, Schneider Electric, Milwaukee Tool, Southwire, and Eaton. Its services include VFD programming and start-up, motor control training, project management, switchgear and lighting quotations, and technical training. The firm serves industrial automation, residential, commercial, utility, and mining markets.

WEDCO's customer base includes industrial pump contractors, residential and commercial electrical contractors, industrial automation and MRO buyers, mining operations, and utility companies. The distributor positions itself as a single source for electrical supplies across Northern Nevada.

The employee-owned structure is cited as a differentiator, aligning employee incentives with customer outcomes. The company emphasizes community involvement, supporting organizations like the University of Nevada, youth sports, and the Boys and Girls Club, and highlights reliable delivery, fast response, and expert project support as core values.
